messages:
julia: Heads-up — getting a small uptick in 502/504s hitting /api/v1/respond over the last 10m, SLO alert triggered. Can someone point me to the best dashboards and which logs/traces to look at first?

omar: Check Grafana -> "HTTP Errors / Gateway" dashboard (team-only). It has a per-route breakdown and upstream latencies. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/errors-gateway

kai: For traces use Honeycomb (or Tempo) — filter on service=inference and span.name="http.request" and url.path=/api/v1/respond. Look for >500ms tail latency and upstream errors. Example filter: service=inference AND url.path:"/api/v1/respond" AND status_code:>=500

matthew: Logs: Kibana > logs-inference. Quick query: 

```
service: "inference" AND request.path: "/api/v1/respond" AND (response.status:502 OR response.status:504)
| sort @timestamp desc
```

That shows nginx upstream timeout patterns and the client ip, upstream host, and response_time fields.

julia: Thanks — seeing a cluster of 504s around 14:02. Any obvious deploys or autoscale events then?

sre-bot: deploy 2026-03-16T13:58Z -> inference-service v3.4.1 started, rollout 100% at 1769004270.

omar: If it's around a rollout, it might be short-lived. Two quick things: 1) check LB -> backend 5xx ratio (Grafana panel) 2) check pod restarts / OOMs in k8s events (kubectl get events -n inference).

kai: Also look at connection pool saturation in the runtime metrics: `runtime.http.connections_active` and `runtime.kv_cache_hits` — if connections spike and qps is stable, you might be hitting upstream workers.

matthew: On alert tuning — we should avoid a noisy 5m window. Proposal: change the 504 alert to evaluate over 15m with a 3% threshold and require at least 50 requests in window (to avoid low-traffic noise). Also add a suppression during deploy window tag.

julia: Sounds reasonable. Any objections to a 15m window + 3% threshold?

omar: +1. Also add an alert label to break down by upstream service so on-call can see whether it's gateway vs backend app.

kai: If we want fewer pagers, convert immediate pager to a P2 (notify #eng-sre but only page on sustained 10m). Send a slack notification for 5m transient alerts.

julia: I'll open a PR to update the alert rule and add the upstream grouping. Can someone paste the runbook link I should reference in the PR?

matthew: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/gateway-502-504-troubleshooting . It lists the usual checks: LB, nginx upstream timeout, backend saturation, recent deploys, and circuit-breaker state.

julia: Perfect — tagging you both on the PR. I'll also add the Grafana and Honeycomb panel links in the description.

omar: One extra tip: add a short-lived synthetic canary for /api/v1/respond (1req/10s) from multiple regions; it helps distinguish infra vs client-side regressions.

kai: Agreed. If we keep the canary, we can route canary alerts to #eng-sre-private only.

julia: Great. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/512 — changes alert window and grouping, adds runbook. Review pinged. :rocket:

matthew: Reviewing now. If all good, we can flip in staging and let it bake for 24h.

sre-bot: alert updated in staging (dry-run) at 1769004380.

julia: Thanks everyone — will monitor the next hour and follow up if we see recurrence.
